text: Access and security - Publisher reports, in Nord-Kivu, insecurity hampering decontamination in parts of Kalunguta and Mabalako, one separate incident in which a body was taken from a safe-burial team, 12 of 32 rings opened, 8 of 22 households decontaminated and a facility score card average of 31.9% in 10 facilities; in Ituri insufficient reception capacity in several CTE/CT (including Kilo, Mangala and Mandima) and 12 patients without food support in Mandima; in Bas-Uele 43 suspects in isolation without specific nutritional support. The Ituri burial team shortages, IPC input stockouts and health worker strike restate SR187 and SR185, and the logistics stockout line and the Nord-Kivu security line repeat SR187 verbatim; they are not counted here. No intervention effect is established.
